title: Genetic dissection of grain zinc concentration in spring wheat for mainstreaming biofortification in CIMMYT wheat breeding
authors: Velu, G., Singh, R.P., Crespo-Herrera, L., Juliana, P., Dreisigacker, S., Valluru, R., Stangoulis, J., Sohu, V.S., Mavi, G.S., Mishra, V.K., Balasubramaniam, A., Chatrath, R., Gupta, V., Singh, G.P., Joshi, A.K.
notes: This is a GWAS study on genetic variation in grain Zn concentration across 330 wheat lines in 6 environments. NO Zn fertilizer treatment-control comparisons exist. ZnSO4 (25 kg/ha) was applied uniformly to all plots at CENEB to minimize soil heterogeneity, not as a treatment. Paper reports frequency distributions of grain Zn across environments and SNP-trait associations. No extractable Zn biofortification treatment-control data.
